industrial_policy: Engine/cargo equipment zones are unmanned in normal operation; isolation and maintenance access required before entry. Not automatically habitable. No walking through current hull collision.
emergency_policy: Reserve E01 and bus E03 are independent proposals; no endurance assigned. Manual local isolation survives data loss. Dual egress, separate risers, refuge capacity and reserve sizing remain unproved.
rf_policy: N06 is an interior RF bulkhead interface only; external antenna positions, spectrum, link budgets and propagation unresolved. No wireless dependency for emergency stop.

gaps.gap: Voltages, currents, protection discrimination, conductor gauges and fault energy unknown.
gaps.acceptance: Approve load inventory; size conductors and coordinated breaker trips; test safe shedding.

gaps.gap: Crew count, occupancy hours, gas mixture and reserve endurance unknown.
gaps.acceptance: Set occupancy scenarios; size and test atmosphere control and independent reserve.

gaps.gap: Tank volume, flow, pressure, treatment chemistry and consumption unknown.
gaps.acceptance: Close mass balance; test isolation, contamination detection and quarantine.

gaps.gap: Heat loads, fluids, flow, radiator area and operating temperatures unknown.
gaps.acceptance: Close thermal balance; validate independent loops, leak response and heat rejection.

gaps.gap: Frequencies, link budget, bandwidth, EMC and security boundaries unresolved.
gaps.acceptance: Define permissions and protocols; test segmented control and comms-loss behavior.

gaps.gap: Nodes are anchors, not fitted equipment; cables/pipes lack sizes and collision paths.
gaps.acceptance: Fit actual mesh, trays, supports, wall penetrations and maintenance clearance.

gaps.gap: One reserved access core is not independent dual egress.
gaps.acceptance: Prove refuge/escape routes, fire zoning, door/lift failure and trapped-person recovery.

gaps.gap: Scalar charge is implemented; physical circuits and human-support simulation are not.
gaps.acceptance: Define server state, faults, repair, persistence and authoritative multiplayer acceptance.
